_extraction_context.source_title: In App Purchase Process And Payment Methods
_extraction_context.snippet_primary: "Remember that purchases made through Domestika's app are processed from the Store, so the payment method used and the currency in which prices are shown will be those which you have configured in your associated profile. Furthermore, these platforms will apply their own purchase conditions. That said, prices may vary and will not apply the same purchase conditions for special offers and discounts that are available on Domestika's website."
_extraction_context.subject_exact: Domestika in-app purchases processed through App Store or Google Play with their own payment methods, currencies, and conditions; website prices, offers, and discounts do not apply in-app
